item.title: Study shows certain jobs can influence personality traits, CBS study shows
item.description: New research from Copenhagen Business School suggests that our jobs may not only reflect our personality, but also shape it over time. item.title: Danish exports to the U.S. rise in 2025 despite tariffs and weaker dollar
item.description: Danish companies increased their exports to the United States in 2025, despite tariffs on Danish goods and a falling dollar. Exports of goods and services to the U.S. reached 375 billion DKK, 14 billion more than the previous year, according to Statistics Denmark. It is the highest level ever recorded. item.title: She came to Denmark as a horse trainer, then founded a theatre company: “I did it for the internationals who couldn’t find a way into the Danish theatre”
item.description: After relocating from the United States, she discovered many experienced singers struggling to find work due to language barriers. By reshaping the casting process and building productions around performers’ strengths, she created new opportunities for international artists on Copenhagen stages.
